rules.heldSameReference: hide only the recorded actual stack when actually shown in hand
rules.sameLookingSpare: does not hide the recorded distinct item
rules.gliding: hands grip glider, registered items may show on back
rules.bowUse: bow/crossbow stays in hand and shield may holster to back
rules.elytra: hide shield and ranged, melee remains subject to original wing occlusion

nativeAppearance: Keep ItemStackRenderState FIXED and actual sanitized native components; no baked replacement item texture. Preserve item model, damage, dye, shield base/pattern and enchantment glint. Preview does not emulate runtime effects.
fixedNormalization: Shield FIXED includes translation [-4.5,4.5,-5] and scale [.55,.55,.55]. All centers here are visual targets after native display transforms. Use actual extracted model bounds to compensate origin/offset and derive the body-local transform. Blender canvas angle is a footprint angle; do not paste as Java Euler without verifying its coordinate/rotation order.
modelSource: Reference only: local Minecraft 26.3 native item pixel silhouettes extruded one unit; shield dimensions from ShieldModel plate12x22x1 and handle2x6x6. Not a game replacement model.
developmentBoundary: Only art placement source and spec delivered; no client/server code, stored references, inventory or production dependency changes. Current cape/elytra policies remain.

sizePolicy.humanRequest: 手持与背负模型大小不要有太大差别，盾、弓与武器一致
sizePolicy.projectionNote: Compare world model scale at same camera. First-person screen projection uses different native display context/FOV.
